titulo: Auditor agent: the X-ray, claude-seo, and the list with evidence
lead: The first agent worth building is the one that only reads. It runs the X-ray, runs claude-seo, and returns a list of problems, each with the line that proves it. It fixes nothing: you decide what to change, and the 2026 yardstick filters out what's just a fad.
objetivo: run the read-only X-ray and claude-seo, and have the agent list problems with evidence, changing nothing.

aprende.t: The X-ray in text: auditoria.sh, read-only
claude-seo: what's free and what's paid
The right request: finding, evidence, no changes
Run every recommendation through the 2026 yardstick

hero_alt: Building inspector with a clipboard and a flashlight examines a house's electrical panel and notes what they find.

secoes.titulo: From the X-ray to the list you decide on

nos.detalhe: A curl script that looks at the site the way a search engine does: redirects, robots.txt, sitemaps and, per page, status, title, canonical, hreflang, robots, JSON-LD, and internal links in the HTML. It writes nothing to the site.
An open (MIT) collection of /seo commands for Claude Code: full audit, technical, content, schema, sitemap, hreflang, and GEO. The core is free; the DataForSEO extension is paid.

nos.sub: the agent reads and points out
nos.detalhe: Every finding comes with the exact line from the output. A finding without evidence doesn't go in: it's the agent giving an opinion.
AI SEO tools still recommend llms.txt as a lever and FAQ as a showcase. The yardstick separates them: llms.txt is optional and cheap; the FAQ rich result ended on 05/07/2026.
The agent doesn't know the site's context. A note that looks like an error may be your own choice. The decision to change anything stays with you, and the fix becomes a task with a gate.

secoes.legenda: The auditor only reads. Whoever writes to the site goes through a gate.

texto: Run the method's auditoria.sh with the home page and the pages that matter, and save the output to a file. That's the evidence the agent will read.
The script only makes read requests (curl). It can run on any public site, including a competitor's.
claude-seo needs Python 3.10 or higher and Claude Code. The /seo audit, /seo technical, and /seo geo commands run without paying anything beyond your subscription.
The DataForSEO extension (search volume, SERP, backlinks) requires a paid account: the README mentions a minimum top-up of US$ 50 and US$ 1 for a test (README from 03/06/2026; check the site).

exemplo.texto: Prefer to clone and read install.sh before running it. A script piped straight into bash runs without you seeing what it does.

texto: Ask for a table: finding, evidence line copied from the file, severity, and proposed fix. And say what it can't do: change files, run commands that write, call APIs.
A finding without an evidence line is discarded, as in the check from lesson 3.
claude-seo's GEO module treats llms.txt as an emerging standard, and its schema reference on FAQ dates from 2023. Mark those items as [yardstick] and decide by what holds in 2026.
Blocking a training bot doesn't block a search bot: robots.txt is decided by purpose (course 1, lesson 6).

secoes.titulo: The X-ray, claude-seo, and the request to the agent
secoes.sub: Swap the address for your site.

blocos.conteudo:
git clone https://github.com/inematds/inemaseo-metodo.git
cd inemaseo-metodo
tools/auditoria.sh https://www.seusite.com /pagina-1/ /pagina-2/ > auditoria.txt

git clone https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo.git
cd claude-seo
less install.sh        # read it before running
./install.sh

claude                 # opens Claude Code
/seo audit https://www.seusite.com
/seo technical https://www.seusite.com
/seo geo https://www.seusite.com

Read auditoria.txt (and the /seo audit report, if there is one).
Return a table with up to 10 findings: finding | evidence line copied from the file | severity (high/medium/low) | proposed fix.
Rules:
- A finding without an evidence line doesn't go in.
- Do not change any file, do not run any command that writes, do not call any API.
- Mark [yardstick] every recommendation about llms.txt, FAQ, or "optimizing for AI".
- Bots in robots.txt: separate search, user action, and training.

abas.rot: What the agent should point out
abas.html:
• Redirects: http and non-www go to a single address (308). Nothing to do.
  • robots.txt: ClaudeBot is in the same group as the search bots, but it is a training bot. Decide by purpose.
  • courses-sitemap: 0 hreflang annotations. The agent points it out; you know the context (the listing pages are Portuguese-only and the translated version is a different site).
  • llms.txt 200: [yardstick] optional and cheap, not a citation lever.

secoes.sub: Use your own site. If you don't have one, use a public site you know well.

exercicios.texto: Run auditoria.sh on the home page and 3 more important pages, and save the output to auditoria.txt. If you have Claude Code, also run /seo technical on the home page.
exercicios.pronto: auditoria.txt exists with the 4 pages, each with status, title, canonical and the internal link count.

exercicios.texto: Give the auditor's request to the agent. Check each evidence line against the file and write your decision next to each finding: fix, ignore (with the reason) or [régua].
exercicios.pronto: you have 5 findings, each with a line that really exists in auditoria.txt and your decision, and the project's git status shows the agent changed nothing.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: The auditor agent flagged a problem, but didn't copy any line from the output. What should you do?
opcoes: Accept it: the agent knows SEO.
Discard the finding or ask for the evidence.
Fix it on the site just to be safe.
Run /seo audit again until it agrees.
perguntas.explica: A finding without evidence is an opinion. The request requires the line copied from the output; without it, the finding doesn't make the list.

perguntas.p: What in claude-seo requires a paid account?
perguntas.explica: The core runs with Claude Code and Python. Market data (exact volume, SERP, backlinks) comes from DataForSEO, which is paid. Lesson 7 shows when that pays off.

perguntas.p: In the real output, ClaudeBot appears in the group with OAI-SearchBot and Claude-SearchBot. What is the finding?
opcoes: None: they are all AI bots.
ClaudeBot is a training bot; the decision to allow it should be made by purpose.
You need to block them all.
perguntas.explica: Search, user action and training are different purposes. Allowing or blocking training is a separate decision, and it doesn't affect search.

perguntas.p: The GEO module suggests creating llms.txt to show up more in AI answers. How should you handle it?
opcoes: High priority: it's the new standard.
Mark it [régua]: it's optional and cheap, with no proof of a citation gain.
Ask the agent to publish it right away.
perguntas.explica: An Ahrefs study (137 thousand domains, 06/15/2026) found that 97% of the files get no requests at all. You can have one, but not as a lever.

itens.texto: The auditor reads and points things out. Writing to the site goes through a gate.
Each finding comes with the line that proves it; no line, no entry.
auditoria.sh and the claude-seo core. DataForSEO is optional and paid.
llms.txt is optional; the FAQ rich result ended on 05/07/2026; robots by purpose.
